d:
Kyaa Dil Ne Kahaa's title track personifies romance in all its glory. Udit Narayan and Alka Yagnik come together to make this song one of the most memorable love songs in Bollywood. The film is a Hindi remake of the Telugu film Swayamvaram, directed by Sanjay Chhel. It is a romantic comedy produced by G.A. Sheshagiri Rao. The film stars Esha Deol, Tusshar Kapoor, Rajesh Khanna, Smita Jaykar, Raj Babbar and Nina Kulkarni in other roles. The up-beat music of the film is composed by Himesh Reshammiya.
Song Name - Kyaa Dil Ne Kahaa
Movie - Kyaa Dil Ne Kahaa
Singer - Udit Narayan; Alka Yagnik
